authority: research disposition only; no Core mutation during live comparison
promotionRule: Core earns retain if all trajectories are valid, core correctness is no worse than raw-control by more than one decision across 24 judgments, core holdout-style per-replicate correctness never falls below raw by more than one, and total Provider tokens are <=0.75 of raw-control. Otherwise Core may only narrow; no deletion unless raw strictly dominates correctness and cost.
stopRule: One valid campaign; no V2 tuning solely to preserve Core.

treatments.core-compressed: exact cards + all current core/*.md; no responsibility map/gauntlet closeout
treatments.raw-control: exact cards + current portfolio + responsibility map + existence-gauntlet closeout
